narration: Welcome to the Bronze Gallery. Here we have the magnificent Nataraja, accession number NM 47.14/1, a 12th‑century Chola bronze from Tamil Nadu. The sculpture, about 96 centimetres tall, shows Shiva in his cosmic dance, with his right leg on the dwarf‑demon Muyalaka and his front hand raised in the protective abhaya mudra. This piece exemplifies the Chola mastery of the lost‑wax technique, a tradition that dates back to the Harappan Dancing Girl, and it beautifully captures the five cosmic acts of creation, preservation, destruction, veiling, and grace. Enjoy the exquisite balance and fluidity that make this bronze a pinnacle of Indian art.
